meta.note: Curated YC vs non-YC head-to-head rivalries. Opinions only — not investment advice. Not affiliated with Y Combinator.

competitors.name: Adyen
competitors.one_liner: Global payments platform for enterprise checkout.
competitors.description: Adyen is a Netherlands-based payments company used by large global merchants for online and in-person checkout.

competitors.name: Booking.com
competitors.one_liner: Global online travel agency for stays and trips.
competitors.description: Booking.com is one of the largest OTAs, spanning hotels, homes, and travel inventory worldwide.

competitors.name: Uber Eats
competitors.one_liner: Food delivery network built on Uber's logistics.
competitors.description: Uber Eats competes in on-demand restaurant delivery across most major cities.

competitors.name: Binance
competitors.description: Binance is a major cryptocurrency exchange known for deep liquidity and a wide asset list.

competitors.name: Google Drive
competitors.one_liner: Cloud storage bundled with Google Workspace.
competitors.description: Google Drive is the default cloud file system for many teams already on Gmail/Docs.

competitors.name: Amazon Fresh
competitors.one_liner: Grocery delivery from Amazon's logistics stack.
competitors.description: Amazon Fresh brings grocery delivery into Amazon's Prime membership and fulfillment network.

competitors.name: ADP
competitors.one_liner: Incumbent payroll and HR platform for enterprises.
competitors.description: ADP is a long-running payroll and HCM provider for SMBs through large enterprises.

competitors.name: American Express
competitors.one_liner: Premium cards and corporate spend brand.
competitors.description: American Express dominates premium consumer and corporate card spend with rewards and charge products.

competitors.name: YouTube
competitors.one_liner: Dominant video platform with live streaming.
competitors.description: YouTube is the default destination for on-demand and live video creators and audiences.

competitors.name: Jira
competitors.one_liner: Atlassian's default issue tracker for engineering teams.
competitors.description: Jira is the incumbent project and issue tracking suite for software organizations.

competitors.name: Labelbox
competitors.one_liner: Data labeling and training-data platform for ML teams.
competitors.description: Labelbox helps teams create and manage labeled datasets for machine learning.

competitors.name: Render
competitors.one_liner: Modern cloud host for web apps and services.
competitors.description: Render competes as a developer-friendly alternative to classic PaaS for deploying web services.

battles.title: Stripe vs Adyen
battles.left_argument: Developer-first APIs, docs, and startup default.
battles.right_argument: Enterprise global acquiring and unified commerce at scale.

battles.title: Airbnb vs Booking.com
battles.left_argument: Homes and experiences brand with community trust.
battles.right_argument: Hotel inventory depth and global OTA distribution.

battles.title: DoorDash vs Uber Eats
battles.left_argument: US density and merchant tooling focus.
battles.right_argument: Global Uber network and multi-vertical logistics.

battles.title: Dropbox vs Google Drive
battles.left_argument: Focused sync product and cross-platform files.
battles.right_argument: Free bundling with Google account and Docs.

battles.title: Instacart vs Amazon Fresh
battles.left_argument: Retailer marketplace and local shopper network.
battles.right_argument: Prime logistics and Amazon retail gravity.

battles.title: Gusto vs ADP
battles.left_argument: SMB-friendly UX and modern benefits stack.

battles.title: Brex vs American Express
battles.left_argument: Startup spend controls and software-native cards.
battles.right_argument: Rewards brand and corporate charge network.

battles.title: Twitch vs YouTube
battles.left_argument: Live community culture and gaming identity.
battles.right_argument: Audience scale and creator monetization surface.

battles.title: Heroku vs Render
battles.left_argument: Original developer PaaS with add-on ecosystem.
battles.right_argument: Modern pricing and DX without legacy baggage.

battles.title: Scale AI vs Labelbox
battles.left_argument: Full-stack data engine for frontier AI labs.
battles.right_argument: Self-serve labeling workflows for ML teams.
